subject: general
question: **Which of the following is NOT a message that the passage gives us? **

options.text: Adversities have opportunities as well as obstacles inherent in them.
Those who are positive are fragile and can be easily shattered by difficulties.
We have to change our view point and adopt a more positive and solution-driven attitude towards difficulties.
Difficulties enable us to become stronger as we learn to face them.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Those who are positive are fragile and can be easily shattered by difficulties.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The last sentence of the first paragraph in the given passage states that- *"negative people and clay pots are fragile__; once shattered, they are broken forever​"*
 
• That means "**Both negative people and clay pots are delicate; once broken, they cannot be repaired.**"
 
• The word **'positive' **and **'fragile'** both are **contradictory **to each other. That means **"positive people can't be fragile."**

From here we can conclude that option 2 is the right answer.
